Definition: raw labelled-profile count in the hemisphere contralateral to the hemisection
Note: raw, before the stereological correction
Source Note: printed to the left in the "Maximum profile #" cell

Definition: raw labelled-profile count in the ipsilateral hemisphere, printed only where it exceeded the contralateral count
Note: NA in 19 of 24 species = not printed, not zero; present for 3 hedgehogs + mole + hyrax

Definition: which bracket the printed parenthetical used
Source Note: typesetting inconsistency recorded rather than normalised

Definition: the profile count the paper carried into the correction: ipsilateral where printed, otherwise contralateral
Note: derived in the .R; reproduces CS_somata_total exactly for 24/24

Definition: which hemisphere CS_profiles_used came from
Note: contralateral (19) / ipsilateral (5)

Definition: mean CS soma diameter (perimeter converted to an equivalent diameter)
Note: somata sampled in the densest labelled zone, so this over-estimates the mean over all CS somata (the paper says so, p. 199)
Source Note: computerised planograph; um as printed

Definition: stereological overcounting-correction factor applied to the raw profile count
Note: recomputes as round(100/(100+soma_diameter.um),3) for 24/24 rows
Source Note: Nudo & Masterton 1989; corrects for soma size, section thickness and minimum countable profile size

Definition: estimated total number of corticospinal somata after the stereological correction
Note: the value every later analysis in the paper uses; mean over 24 species = 24,071, as the paper states
Source Note: HRP applied to a C1-C2 spinal hemisection; TMB; labelled profiles counted in at least every 5th 50-um section
